title: The pack enforces WordPress and TypeScript correctness records with plants
body:
Why: Fable 1115g slice 5; privilege holes in client plugins cost 4-8 h plus an incident.
Outcome: enforced records for REST permission_callback, capability check beside nonce, sanitised input before update_option or meta, and TS floating promises, each with a plant.
Files: standards/records.json, test/scripts/planted-records.test.ts, scripts/standards-audit.ts.
Proof: planted matrix N/N, false-red 0 on one public WordPress plugin clone.
Serial: changes the enforced set and planted matrix.
